summary: Operator site refused (Mod_Security 406); read the park's Park With Us booking engine (site list, config, policies), profile, map, Google 4.6 (75) and imagery. Fees added $45 (weekly $270, monthly $650), passes price gate. Electric 30 -> 50 (all RV sites 30/50), water, no sewer. Sites 35 -> 38 (34 RV + 4 primitive), max 70 ft, pull_through true -> unknown (all back-in, one hybrid). Season 04-01 to 11-30 confirmed from engine config. Nightly share: 19 RV + 4 tent of 38 bookable online (61%). Military 10%. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Price gate: passes - $45 a night (the only RV rate). Google 4.6 (75 reviews); Park With Us 4.6 (62).

LONG-STAY: nightly share about 23 of 38 (61%). Park With Us marks 19 of the 34 RV sites bookable online (A-2..A-6, B-1..B-8, C-1, C-4, C-7, C-8, D-3, D-5) plus all four primitive tent sites; the other 15 RV sites (A-1, A-7, C-2, C-3, C-5, C-6, C-9..C-11, D-1, D-2, D-4, D-6..D-8) are not bookable online and are presumably seasonal. Nightly rate posted and bookable online; 1-night minimum; no discouraging wording ('parking your RV for a full-season stay or setting up a tent for a quiet weekend'). Passes; no 'Mostly seasonal' line needed. No availability search run.

Sites: stored count 35 (note prose) -> 38. Stored pull_through true came from note prose ('3 pull-throughs'); the engine lists every RV site as back-in except D-4 'hybrid', so pull_through is cleared to unknown. Several online sites are short: A-2, A-3, A-5 26 ft, B-7 30 ft - a 23-ft rig fits all of them.
Stored inclusion_evidence says 'Operator page (via parkwith.us) ... nightly from $45, currently booking': accurate and still current.
Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: the map's 'Spring' is a small spring pond north of the D loop; imagery shows no open water among the wooded sites along Covered Bridge Road.
Pin 43.3697,-90.4237 is within about 150 m of the loops (Park With Us lists 43.371167,-90.423994; the trailers on imagery sit about 43.3701,-90.4227): OK.
